notes.title: Treasure Hunters - Dungeon Themes, Emotes & Network optimization
notes.notes: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers,[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Emotes:[/b][/h3][p]This week, I implemented a emote system and added 8 of them. Incase you get the references let me know when the game comes out.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889558/3f59a59d4b95e3fb80024b2895323b41d96dd970.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Dungeon Themes:[/b][/h3][p]Someone gave a bad review to the Prologue, saying "both 2 dungeons look the same" and I couldn't agree more. So I implemented a theme system, every dungeon will have their own theme based on their lore. Yes I also finished the lores of the all dungeons.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889558/12d422c9d2d3caf836a0847ecfe031c63996768c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Network Optimization:[/b][/h3][p]The main reason dungeon wall sometimes not spawning on the clients were because of the high bandwith requirement. [/p][p][/p][p]I've got an exam this week and I'm finally graduating from my annoying ass school but until next week I'll be working on finishing the all dungeon themes, optimizing and data save.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, keep hunting ːIndyː[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Also, don't forget to wishlist Treasure Hunters :[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters - Rat Swarm Enemy & New Tools
notes.notes: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers, [/p][p]This week I worked on a new freaky ah enemy and added a couple of new tools to use. I hope you like it.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]RATS:[/b][/h3][p]I was inspired by Plague Tale while making this enemy. Every single rat has really low hp but you can hit one at a time. So kicking, shooting with pistol etc. might not work on them. You will need to find another way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/977eb62c6e768b5bfc34633df48ccbfb518d1c0e.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]NEW ITEMS:[/b][/h3][p][b]Dynamite: F*CKING KABOOM! And if you are too lazy to solve the puzzle, just make the door non existent ;)[/p][p][b]Insect Repeller: [/b]Keeps the insects (ants, mosquitos, spiders) away until the battery is ran out.[/p][p][b]Map creator:[/b] Creates the layout of the dungeon while the owner is roaming around. notes.title: Treasure Hunters: Prologue - v1.2 Update YOU CAN PLAY LATEST VERSION FREE HERE

Most of the objects used to work server side so clients used to wait for a bit of time to get a feedback from anything. With this update most of the gears, items, mechanics etc. works client sided. So clients will get an instant feedback even if they have very high pings. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Also you can play the prologue for free here:[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669530/Treasure_Hunters_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Here are the changes I made in this update:[/p][p][b]FEATURES:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Added a more clear tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged Enemies will miss by chance if is lightened by a flashlight (for example, you can point a flashlight at a mosquito to miss when they shoot)[/p][/*][*][p]Random treasures spawn system by specified rarity[/p][/*][*][p]Lever has two notifications for cooldown and for stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Inspectable Paper better rotation (F*CKING FINALLY)[/p][/*][*][p]High Ping Warning for clients[/p][/*][*][p]Players spawn blood particles when get damaged[/p][/*][*][p]Less report noise call from footsteps[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes on enemies' hearing settings[/p][/*][*][p]Now the overall treasure value for a dungeon is multiplied by the DungeonGrowth OverallTreasureValue * (TileAmount/ExpectedTileAmount)[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]CLIENT SIDED REWORKS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hit Feedback Client side[/p][/*][*][p]InspectableItems are now client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Yohu's Heart is client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Artifact Holder picking up is client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Door Opening Effects are client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Coffin opening is client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Halucination Objects are now Works client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Incenses Work client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Openable secret chambers now work client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Drain now Works client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Glowing Button now Works client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Holdable Valve now works client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Pickupable objects disappears immedieately for clients before spawning in their hand. (Faster Feedback)[/p][/*][*][p]Blowing Dart only works for client bug is fixed (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Flashlight now works client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Rarity Detector turkish characters are missing[/p][/*][*][p]Rarity Detector now works client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Dropping Objects are now client sided (faster feedback right after pressing G)[/p][/*][*][p]Gun hitbacks are now client sided.[/p][/*][*][p]Switching Items now works on client side[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Main artifact doesnt count at the end bug is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Removed "Change mesh" object from game[/p][/*][*][p]Pushing a player without kicking them bug is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies interact with keys bug is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Sack can duplicate items bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Friends button doesnt work after a friend join bug is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Spectator ui text fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Weird animation while picking up animation while crouching is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up animation on client doesnt work[/p][/*][*][p]While crouching and sliding, not falling of edges bug is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed seeing head while swimming[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flame traps not working sometimes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed moving logs in DeathRun room (in full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Mirrors turning slower on low fps bug is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Internet connection pop up, bux is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Squeezer trap going through the wall bug[/p][/*][*][p]Weird gates in lava pit room is fixed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That was a busy ass week, and it will be even busier for the next couple of weeks, but I'm dedicated to bringing your dream Co-op Indy game to reality. notes.title: DEVLOG - 4 Aztec Warrior & 10 New Rooms
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Adventurers,

In this update, I added a new Aztec Warrior enemy, a new findable gun and 10 new rooms to the Treasure Hunters.

[h2][b]Aztec Warriors:[/b][/h2]
Aztec Warriors are people who live in the dungeons, unaware of the outside world. They are the final remnants of the Aztec race. And they will fight anything to save their dungeons.
[list]
[*] If an Aztec Warrior is far enough, he will shoot sleeping darts at you and will beat you to death while you're unconscious.
[*] If he is close enough, he'll rush in with his macuahuitl! And if you aim at him, he'll try to dodge it.
[*] When his health drops, he escapes, heals himself,f and keeps firing darts!
[/list]

[h2][b]Blowgun:[/b][/h2]
Blowgun is an old Aztec Weapon that can be found in the dungeons and dropped from an Aztec Warrior. The darts of the blowgun will put the target to sleep for 5 seconds if hit.

[h2][b]10 New Rooms:[/b][/h2]
With every update I'm adding 10 new rooms so. Again I added 10.


[h3][b]Aztec Warriors:[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Headlight open close with [F]
[*] Ragdoll camera is much better.
[*] And some bug fixes etc...
[/olist]

[h2][b]Next Update:[/b][/h2]
I'll be adding last 10 rooms and it would be done with the rooms before the game release. After that I'm planning to add 2-3 more enemies and start doing some polishes.

notes.title: New Enemy & 10 New Rooms
notes.notes:
Hi Hunters, 

In this update I added a new Enemy called Chaneque, Hearing Sense for Enemies and 10 new Rooms. 

[b][h1]Chaneque[/h1][/b]
Chaneque is a mythical Aztec creature that lived in Mesoamerica. "those who inhabit dangerous places" or "owners of the house" in Náhuatl. These small, sprite-like beings hold a connection to elemental forces and are regarded as guardians of nature.
[list]
[*] In the Treasure Hunters, Chaneques will follow you and ask for a small valuable item of yours. 
[*] You can either give your treasure or just run away or kill him. 
[*] If you hurt him or don't give him a treasure in time he will start crying. Which will make you dizzy and will attract all nearby enemies with his high pitch voice.
[/list]

[b][h2]Hearing Sense[/h2][/b]
Yes, enemies can now hear your gunshot, movement, etc. So be careful where you use your gun.

[b][h1]10 New Rooms[/h1][/b]
Again I added 10 new rooms and all of them have their own mechanics. (I actually loved this update's new rooms). 


Also fixed this:
If you add an item right after the start, it doesn't get bought and spent money but it is added at the end of the adventure

[h1]Next Update[/h1]
I'm planning to add 10 more new rooms which will make up to 40 rooms with the current ones and add a new Enemy.

notes.title: DEVLOG - 2 Item Tiers & New Enemy
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Adventurers,

In this update I added a new enemy and made extra 2 tiers for every Item available at the shop.


[h2][b]Ant Enemy[/b][/h2]

The ants will be roaming around the dungeon and creating holes. If you pass by one of those holes there's a chance an ant will burst out of it, attacks you and run backs to it's hole. If they see you in the dungeon they will attack or run away based on their health. If they are in the roaming stage they will heal themselves overtime. 


[h2][b]Item Tiers[/b][/h2]

I made every Item include 3 Tiers. Not only the appearance but also the mechanics change between the tiers. Here are few examples.

[list]

notes.title: DEVLOG 1 - Level System & 10 New Rooms
notes.notes:
As I mentioned before I'm no longer be updating the Demo until the release of the game. Tho I will be keep posting updates and Devlogs here. 

[u][h2]Level System[/h2][/u]
Players will now earn XPs with every game they play. From extracting treasures, killing creatures and from some other upcoming mechanics. With the XPs you will Level Up and will access to new tools and new tool tiers. So you will be able to play in other dungeons.

[b][h2]10 New Rooms[/h2][/b]
Until now there way 8 rooms in the room pool and the procedural generator was choosing some of them to spawn in the dungeon. I added 10 completely new rooms so there's now 18. And I'm planning to add at least 30 more before the release. Rooms takes a lot of time since most of them have their own mechanics, puzzles, elements etc. But you can be sure it will be worth to wait.


[b]Bug Fixes:
[/b]
One puzzle room used to spawn a spider even in a non creature dungeon, it is now fixed.
Fixed hall events spawning outside the dungeon bug 
Loading screen on clients fixed

I will most likely be adding new treasures, new tools and teirs this week to expand the game a bit more. 

So, keep hunting and see you next update ːsansː
